notes.pl: Patina Client: 11 nowych modów (AppleSkin, Shulker Tooltip, Speedometer, Zoom, Ping, Perspective, Horse Stats, Status Effects, Weather Changer, Death Info, No Fog), katalog modów z wyszukiwarką i płynniejsza animacja ładowania.
notes.en: Patina Client: 11 new mods (AppleSkin, Shulker Tooltip, Speedometer, Zoom, Ping, Perspective, Horse Stats, Status Effects, Weather Changer, Death Info, No Fog), a searchable catalogue of mods and a smoother loading animation.
